summary: A playable prototype with recognizable low-poly Waymo cars, hilly SF streets, and active laser tag combat, but heavily penalized by thick washed-out fog, landmarks placed inside the street grid, and broken building collision where the player car clips halfway inside a blinding white wall.

top_issues.issue: Thick white fog/haze washes out the entire scene and ruins contrast, directly violating the sunny clear daytime visual goal.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 0-4 show heavy white distance fog starting just a couple of blocks away, washing out buildings and landmarks.
top_issues.fix_hint: Remove scene.fog or drastically increase its far distance, and use a crisp blue skybox with strong directional sunlight and shadows.

top_issues.issue: Broken building collision and camera clipping: the car drives halfway inside an untextured, blindingly white building wall and slides along it.
top_issues.evidence: Video 00:29-00:35 and Screenshot 5 show the right half of the player car embedded inside a pure white building mesh blocking half the screen.
top_issues.fix_hint: Ensure all building meshes have proper AABB/box colliders that push the car out cleanly without letting the vehicle or camera clip inside, and fix overexposed white wall materials.

top_issues.issue: Landmarks are placed directly inside the city street grid rather than in their realistic geographic locations.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 3 and 4 (and Video 00:16-00:22) show a red Golden Gate Bridge tower/cable structure and the Transamerica Pyramid sitting directly on a residential street corner.
top_issues.fix_hint: Place the Golden Gate Bridge and Bay Bridge over water outside the street grid perimeter, and group downtown skyscrapers (Transamerica, Salesforce) in a dedicated financial district.

top_issues.issue: Low-poly lollipop trees and blocky pastel buildings lack San Francisco architectural detail, and some bushes/trees sit in the middle of the road.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshot 0 and 1 show green bushes/trees sitting in the roadway at the crest of the hill; Screenshot 4 and 5 show simple sphere-on-cylinder trees and flat-shaded buildings.
top_issues.fix_hint: Remove all vegetation from roadways, use more detailed tree models on sidewalks, and add authentic Victorian bay window profiles, cornices, and varied facade textures.

top_issues.issue: The Waymo vehicle model is a boxy low-poly sedan rather than a sleek sloped-roof Jaguar I-PACE SUV.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 0-4 show the player car from behind with a squared-off trunk and boxy cabin, though it does include the roof lidar dome, corner sensors, and 'W' logo.
top_issues.fix_hint: Refine the car mesh to match the Jaguar I-PACE coupe-SUV silhouette with a fastback sloped rear window, wider fenders, and clearer Waymo door branding.

top_issues.issue: Heavy white fog/haze and overexposed lighting wash out the entire scene, directly violating the clear sunny daytime requirement.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 0-5 all show thick white distance fog starting just a block away, washing out the Golden Gate Bridge and buildings into near-solid white.
top_issues.fix_hint: Remove scene.fog completely or push far distance much further back, reduce ambient/hemisphere light intensity, and use a crisp blue skybox with high-contrast directional sunlight.

top_issues.issue: Buildings lack proper collision detection, allowing the player car to drive straight inside building geometry and blinding the camera.
top_issues.evidence: Video 00:28-00:35 and Screenshot 5 show the car driving onto the sidewalk and clipping half-way inside a bright white building wall, blocking 60% of the camera view.
top_issues.fix_hint: Add AABB or box collider checks for all city block buildings so the car bounces or slides along walls instead of penetrating them, and add camera collision raycasting.

top_issues.issue: Landmarks and props are placed directly inside the roadway and street grid rather than in realistic locations.
top_issues.evidence: Screenshot 0-2 show bushes/planters sitting in the middle of the road at the top of the hill, and Screenshot 3 shows a giant red Golden Gate Bridge tower base standing directly on a city sidewalk/street corner.
top_issues.fix_hint: Move the Golden Gate Bridge outside the city street grid over a bay water plane to the north/west, and keep all planters, trees, and props strictly on sidewalks or medians.
